tool.name: mumemto inversion
tool.command:
ln -s '$m' input.mums && ln -s '$l' input.lengths && #if $f: ln -s '$f' input.filelist && #end if #if $scaffold.use_agp == 'yes': ## Stage the AGP datasets and build the filelist here: mumemto reads the paths ## listed in that file, and a user-supplied list would point outside the job dir. #for $i, $agp in enumerate($scaffold.agp_files): ln -s '$agp' 'agp_${i}.agp' && echo 'agp_${i}.agp' >> agp_list.txt && #end for ## AGP files are matched against the non-reference sequences only, so one too many ## runs off the end of mumemto's list with an opaque IndexError. nseq=\$(awk '{ if (\$2 == "*") n++ } END { print (n ? n : NR) }' input.lengths) && { [ \$(wc -l < agp_list.txt) -lt \$nseq ] || { echo "Error: \$(wc -l < agp_list.txt) AGP files given for \$nseq sequences - supply at most one per non-reference sequence." >&2; exit 1; }; } && #end if
mumemto inversion --mums input.mums ## Sequence names come from the filelist; mumemto falls back to <prefix>.lengths, but ## pass it explicitly so the link above is doing visible work. #if $f: --filelist input.filelist #else: --filelist input.lengths #end if --max-block-gap-len $g #if str($max_length): --max-length $max_length #end if #if $scaffold.use_agp == 'yes': --agp-filelist agp_list.txt --chr '$scaffold.chr' --margin $scaffold.margin #end if > 'inversions.tsv'

param.label: Maximum inversion length
param.help: Leave empty to report inversions of any length. Otherwise inversions spanning more than this many bases are dropped.

param.name: use_agp
param.label: Check whether inversions are flanked by scaffold breaks
param.help: Requires an AGP file for each non-reference assembly.

param.name: agp_files
param.label: AGP files
param.help: One per non-reference sequence, in the same order as the sequences in the lengths file. The first sequence is the reference and has no AGP file.

param.label: Chromosome identifier
param.help: Without the 'chr' prefix - enter 1 for chr1. mumemto prepends 'chr' when matching AGP records, so passing 'chr1' here matches nothing and aborts.

validator.message: Use only letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens

param.label: Scaffold break margin
param.help: A scaffold break counts as flanking an inversion when it falls within this fraction of the inversion's length from either end.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Detects inversions from mumemto MUMs output by finding runs of collinear blocks that appear in reverse order and on the opposite strand in one assembly relative to the first. The first sequence of the run is always treated as the reference.
Optionally cross-references each inversion against AGP files, reporting whether a scaffold break falls near either boundary — a hint that the apparent inversion is an assembly artefact rather than real biology.
**Input**
- A `.mums` file from mumemto - The `.lengths` file from that run, which also supplies the sequence names - For the scaffold check, one AGP file per **non-reference** sequence, in the same order as the sequences in the lengths file
Enter the chromosome as the bare identifier, for example `1` rather than `chr1`: mumemto prepends `chr` itself when matching AGP records.
**Output**
A tab-separated file, one row per inversion, with a header. Columns are the assembly name, the inversion's start and end in that assembly, and the corresponding reference coordinates. With the scaffold check enabled, two further columns report whether a break was found and which contigs it belongs to.
A file containing only the header means no inversions were detected.
